findings.description: SYS-SUP-018 leaves the configuration bytes covered by the CRC and the treatment of the stored reference undecided. CON-SUP-107 and CON-SUP-129 do not resolve them, so a verifier cannot determine the expected CRC for a configuration block.
findings.requested_change: Obtain a product decision on the covered byte range and treatment of the reference, then specify them.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-043 leaves fault-report priority undecided when a service answer is already being transmitted. CON-SUP-139 gives fault reports priority, and CON-SUP-112 requires a report within 10 ms; the line behavior for this case is incomplete.
findings.requested_change: Obtain a product decision on line behavior when a fault report arises during an answer, and specify the resulting priority and timing.

findings.description: CON-SUP-112 requires fault reports within 10 ms, but SYS-SUP-034 requires a code 8 report without a time limit. CON-SUP-137 says that report is not a fault detection, and CON-SUP-141 identifies its timestamp but does not settle the transmission deadline.
findings.requested_change: Obtain a product decision on the code 8 report deadline and its starting instant, then specify the applicable timing.

findings.description: CON-SUP-112 specifies the FLT line format for fault reports, including code 8. SYS-SUP-034 requires a code 8 report, but SYS-SUP-039 requires the FLT format only when a fault is detected; CON-SUP-137 says the code 8 report is not a fault detection.
findings.requested_change: Specify that the code 8 report uses the required FLT line format and termination.
